message.content:
Here’s a classic lasagna recipe with all the essential ingredients:

| Category | Ingredient | Typical Amount (for a 9×13‑inch pan) |
|----------|------------|--------------------------------------|
| **Lasagna noodles** | Dry lasagna sheets (no‑boil or regular) | 12–15 sheets |
| **Meat sauce** | Ground beef (or a mix of beef & pork) | 1½–2 lb (680–900 g) |
| | Onion, finely chopped | 1 medium |
| | Garlic cloves, minced | 2–3 |
| | Crushed tomatoes or tomato sauce | 28 oz (800 g) |
| | Tomato paste | 2 Tbsp |
| | Olive oil | 2 Tbsp |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Italian seasoning or dried basil & oregano | 1 tsp each |
| | Red pepper flakes (optional) | pinch |
| | Fresh basil or parsley (optional) | handful, chopped |
| | Sugar (to balance acidity) | 1 tsp |
| **Ricotta mixture** | Ricotta cheese | 15 oz (425 g) |
| | Egg (helps bind) | 1 large |
| | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| | Salt, pepper | to taste |
| | Fresh parsley or basil | handful, chopped |
| **Mozzarella** | Shredded mozzarella cheese | 2–3 cups (200–300 g) |
| **Parmesan topping** | Grated Parmesan cheese | ½ cup (50 g) |
| **Optional extras** | Spinach, sliced mushrooms, zucchini, or bell peppers | 1–2 cups, sautéed |
| | Béchamel sauce (white sauce) | 2–3 cups (optional, for richer layers) |

**Basic assembly steps:**

1. **Cook the noodles** (if not no‑boil) until al dente, then drain and set aside.
2. **Prepare the meat sauce**: sauté onion & garlic in olive oil, add ground meat until browned, stir in tomatoes, paste, herbs, salt, pepper, and simmer for 20–30 min.
3. **Mix ricotta filling**: combine ricotta, egg, Parmesan, herbs, salt, and pepper.
4. **Layer**: start with a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of the pan, then noodles, ricotta mixture, mozzarella, and sauce. Repeat until all layers are used, finishing with sauce and a generous topping of mozzarella and Parmesan.
5. **Bake**: cover with foil (to prevent sticking, spray foil with cooking spray) and bake at 375 °F (190 °C) for 25 min. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 min until bubbly and golden.
6. **Rest**: let the lasagna sit 10–15 min before cutting.

Enjoy your homemade lasagna!
